reasons.plausibility: The claim that lattice distortion promotes super-jogging and retains dislocation strength at high temperature aligns well with known effects of configurational complexity in RHEAs, though the specific super-jog mechanism requires further evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled composition variation and in-situ TEM provides a clear, feasible experimental route to confirm or refute the role of thermal super-jogging in the high-distortion alloy.
reasons.usefulness: It gives a targeted, mechanistic explanation and an experiment-based approach to separate the effect of lattice distortion from other factors, which is directly relevant for optimizing high-temperature RHEA performance.
